summary: קוֹץ names a thorn or thorny plant. In Genesis 3:18 the singular describes the thorns that spring from the ground alongside thistles.

senses.definition: A thorn or thorn-bearing plant. The singular can refer collectively to thorny growth.

evidence.note: The ground causes קוֹץ to sprout alongside דַּרְדַּר “thistle,” identifying it as a kind of plant.
